name: Practiced Climber
body:
You have spent many hours practicing your climbing, growing faster as a result.

Prerequisite: Skill Focus (Climb)

Benefit: Your speed when climbing increases by 1 for every rank of the Climb skill you possess.

Normal: Your climb speed is normally 1/4 or 1/2 your regular speed.
